messages:
Maria Chen: ok team — quick sync on the Sundance on‑prem/VPC peering postmortem followups. I compiled the action items from the PM and SRE notes, need owners and ETA.
Raj Patel: I can own the VPC peering verification and routing hardening. ETA: EOD Thu for initial changes, full rollout next Wed if tests pass.
Ellie Wong: I'll take the on‑prem bastion access checklist and vendor coordination (Sundance network ops). Aim to have vendor signoff by next Tue.
Kevin Ortiz: I'll handle the isolation bug regression (kernel-level socket leak) — repro + unit test by Monday. Need a staging kernel build from infra.
Samina Iqbal: I'll add the remediation tasks to the postmortem board and create recurring weekly triage for similar isolation signals. Setting cadence to Fridays 10am.
Maria Chen: thanks. can we add brief acceptance criteria per item? keeps handoffs clean.
Raj Patel: acceptance: peering sessions remain stable for 24h under 10k concurrent connections and no route flaps >1 per hour. I'll upload test plan.
Ellie Wong: acceptance: vendor confirms config applied and we see expected bgp route tags in their edge logs for 48h.
Kevin Ortiz: acceptance: unit tests catch the socket leak pattern and e2e shows no file descriptor growth over 6h load.
Samina Iqbal: added AC to board and linked the postmortem doc. created ticket SD-4817 (peering-hardening), SD-4818 (bastion-vendor), SD-4819 (isolation-bug).
incident-bot: Incident #SUND-2026 marked RESOLVED. Postmortem filed: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/SUND-2026
Maria Chen: timeline risk note — infra said limited staging GPU time this week. Kevin, coordinate with infra for kernel build priority.
Kevin Ortiz: pinging @ops-bot for staging slot.
ops-bot: @Kevin Ortiz — reserved staging slot Thu 02:00-06:00 UTC. Please confirm build artifacts by Wed EOD.
Kevin Ortiz: confirmed, I'll have artifacts Wed 18:00 UTC.
Raj Patel: one more ask — can we add a fallback routing policy for Dedicated when BGP adjacency to Sundance is flaky? small temp ACLs maybe.
Ellie Wong: agree. I can get a draft fallback ACL and test matrix.
Maria Chen: great. owners summary: Raj=peering hardening, Ellie=bastion+vendor, Kevin=isolation bug, Samina=tracking/cadence. Deliverables + acceptance in board.
Raj Patel: will update SD-4817 with playbook and rollback steps.
Samina Iqbal: scheduling the first weekly triage for Fri 10am and inviting all stakeholders + Sundance ops rep.
Maria Chen: thanks everyone. I'll check in Thu after Raj's initial tests. If anything slips, flag here. :thumbsup: 
Ellie Wong: noted. adding network dumps and sample bgp logs to the ticket now.
Kevin Ortiz: creating PR for test harness tomorrow.
Maria Chen: closing for now — keep thread updated.
